rule: Each status has a duration and a level. Re-apply extends the duration (dur_add_perc, default 100 percent), then sets the level one of three ways: derived from duration (bleed: ceil(duration / int_dur_factor)), stepped by int_add_val and capped, or set explicitly by the caller. Per turn each effect decays its level every int_decay_tick turns (on the global clock, only while duration is below max), ends at duration 0, and rolls a kill check. The level floors at 1 unless int_decay_remove is set. Hits add stuns by size class (tiny x4, small x2, medium x1, large /2, huge /4) and knockdown on falls and tangles.

data_fields.name: decayRemove
data_fields.unit: bool; level may reach 0 and end

data_fields.name: durAddPercent
data_fields.unit: percent of new duration added on re-apply

data_fields.name: stun_size_multiplier
data_fields.unit: ratio per size class (tiny, small, medium, large, huge)

keep: Time as severity: a derived level (bleed) means one number drives both the word and the damage
Stepped level on each re-apply with a cap, so repeated hits cannot exceed maxLevel
Word ladder per level, so the player reads severity from text
Decay runs before the death check in the same per-turn pass
Size classes scale stun time through one table, not per-creature code
change: Defect: decay phase is set by the global turn clock (effect.cpp 1056), so the first decay can come anywhere from one turn to a full tick after application. Fix: per-instance sinceDecay timer.

Defect: the level floor is implicit (set to 1 unless int_decay_remove), so decaying effects can sit at level 1 with no visible end. Fix: make the end explicit in the data (decayRemove) and show the floor in the word ladder.
Do not port item destruction from statuses; one-ledger rule means no status destroys items
Express all numbers as zone and creature data fields, never as constants in the engine
look_test: Phone, 375 wide, about 5 minutes: one duel against a single brute with three quick hits and one wall push. Style flag on the existing duel scene: ?statusLevel=time or ?statusLevel=hits. time = word and damage follow remaining time (donor rule); hits = level steps only on each hit. Compare a 20-second clip of the status line in each. Publish the flag to the preview folder with no release rows and no lock.
